Resolver checks timing: Battle Phase.
Resolver gets valid enemy Heroes from source Hero Attack Coverage during Battle Phase.
Player chooses one enemy Hero from valid Coverage.
Pay Mana after source and resolver validation pass.
Resolve attack damage and per-affected-hero DEF Response windows.
Source Hero Exhausts after successful normal own-turn Skill use unless card says otherwise.
Move Skill Card to Discard after full resolution unless the card creates an attachment/active effect or returns elsewhere by explicit rule.

target.selection_rule: player chooses 1 enemy Hero from valid Attack Coverage

resolver.coverage_rule: Coverage only applies during Battle Phase attacks; support/heal ignore Coverage.
resolver.foundation_note: Target belongs to Resolver, not top-level Skill Card.

post_resolution.connected_definition: not canceled, not negated, not dodged; block to 0 still connects

tribute.destination: under active Hero Mode as EXP stack

swap_reposition_policy.trigger: after attack successfully resolves; unavailable if attack is canceled, negated, or dodged
swap_reposition_policy.runtime_state_update: must update controller board state and preserve Hero instance attachments/statuses with the moved Hero

post_resolution.connected_definition: not canceled, not negated, not dodged; Block to 0 still connects

runtime_resolver.coverage_rule: Coverage only applies during Battle Phase attacks; support/heal ignore Coverage.
runtime_resolver.foundation_note: Target belongs to Resolver, not top-level Skill Card.

effect_strings_by_class.Paladin: You may swap this Hero's position with the allied Hero in front of the attacked enemy Hero. Deal 50 Physical damage.
effect_strings_by_class.Crusader: You may swap this Hero's position with the allied Hero in front of the attacked enemy Hero. Deal 70 Physical damage.

canonical_cost.payment_timing: after source and resolver validation pass
canonical_cost.validation_failure_rule: no mana payment, no Exhaust, no discard

canonical_legality.valid_targets: Opponent Hero inside source Hero Area of Attack only.

source_requirement.class_rank_label: Paladin Rank II; Crusader Rank III

rank_gate.runtime_rule: Active Hero is legal when one printed Skill row exists in its canonical lineage/dual-class access profile. Resolve the highest matching available row.

hybrid_resolution.rule: Hybrid source uses explicit card row if present; otherwise fallback by origin lineage. Crusader uses Crusader row, else Paladin row, else origin row. Paladin uses Paladin row, else origin row.
hybrid_resolution.legacy_note: Hybrid class has no special Legacy; Legacy follows base lineage.

staging.instant_resolution: enters source Hero Attachment Slot, resolves, then moves to Discard
staging.persistent_resolution: casting/buff/ongoing Skill remains in source Hero Attachment Slot until resolve/expire/fail
staging.slot_full_rule: if source Hero has no empty Attachment Slot, Skill play is illegal
staging.casting_policy: Casting Skill stays in source Hero Attachment Slot with pending_casting state; no Casting Zone exists.
staging.attachment_policy: instant/transient action; may show temporary played/pending visual, but must not require or occupy persistent Attachment Slot after resolution.

cost.payment_timing: after source and resolver validation pass
cost.validation_failure_rule: no mana payment, no Exhaust, no discard
